info.title: CardDemo API
info.description: REST replacement of the CardDemo online CICS transactions; every operation is under /api/v1, and every one but POST /api/v1/signon takes the bearer JWT sign-on returns.

get.summary: Fetch an account for update (CAUP / COACTUPC).
get.description:
Endpoint 5, ENTER while no details are shown. The account number is the raw path text, which
the program's account edit checks before any read; the cross-reference, the account and the
customer are then read, and the response carries the values the map shows with the snapshot
the client echoes in every endpoint 6 request. Dates are typed; the SSN is only `***-**-` and
its last four digits.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with the program's message: 400 when the account number fails its edit, 401
without a valid bearer token, 404 when the cross-reference, the account or the customer is not
found, and 500 when a read fails. A segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded is a 400
with the API's `Invalid path parameters...` and no field, before the program's edit.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: Account number as typed on the screen (11 characters)

200.description: The account and customer as shown, with the snapshot to echo

400.description: The account number failed the program's edit; or a path segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded

404.description: No cross-reference, account or customer was found

500.description: A read failed

put.summary: Validate or save an account update (CAUP / COACTUPC).
put.description:
Endpoint 6, on the details endpoint 5 showed. `aid` `ENTER` runs the change check and the
program's edits and, when the changes pass, answers state `N` with `F5=Save` shown; `PF5` with
the echoed state `N` locks and rewrites the account and the customer, answering state `C`.
Any other key text is read as `ENTER`; F3 and F12 send no request. The date, phone and SSN
parts and the amounts are the raw map text the program's edits check. The SSN parts are
write-only: omitting all three leaves the stored SSN unchanged.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with the program's message: 400 when the body fails validation, nothing
changed or an edit fails; 401 without a valid bearer token; 404 when the re-read finds no
cross-reference, account or customer; 409 when the stored records changed after the fetch; 500
when a read, a lock or a rewrite fails, or the store fails. A segment that is not UTF-8 once
percent-decoded is a 400 with the API's `Invalid path parameters...` and no field, before the
body is read.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: Account number as typed on the screen (11 characters)

200.description: The changes were validated or saved, or the screen restarted

400.description: The body failed validation, nothing changed, or an edit failed; or a path segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded

404.description: The re-read found no cross-reference, account or customer

409.description: The stored records changed after the fetch

500.description: A read, a lock, a rewrite or the store failed

get.summary: List pending authorizations for an account (CPVS / COPAUS0C)
get.description:
ENTER, a request without `page_key`, shows the account's customer, its pending-authorization
summary block and the first page of its pending authorizations in key order. F8 sends the
displayed page's `last_key` with `direction` forward, F7 the first key saved for the page
before with `direction` backward. Without a summary the block reports `summary_found` false
and the list is empty. The page holds `page_size` rows, 5 when absent. The row selection and
PF3 run in the screen.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with 400 for a blank or non-numeric account ID, a malformed query, a
`page_key` that is not an authorization key or, with the API's `Invalid path parameters...`
and no field, an account segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded; 401 without a valid
bearer token; 404 when the account has no cross-reference, account or customer record; 422
for a `page_size` outside 1 to 100; 500 when a read fails, with the program's system-error
text.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: Account ID as typed on the screen (11 characters)

parameters.name: page_key
parameters.description:
F8: the `last_key` of the page shown; F7: the `first_key` the screen saved for the page
before it. The 16 digits of an authorization key exactly as a response renders them; any
other text is rejected with 400 on field `page_key`.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
`forward` (F8) pages after `page_key`, `backward` (F7) from it; absent with a `page_key`
pages forward, and without one the first page is shown whatever the direction.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Rows per page, 1 to 100; absent, the 5 rows of the map. A value outside that range is
rejected with 422 (Bounded Pagination). The screen never sends it.

200.description: The customer and summary block and one page of the account's pending authorizations

400.description: A blank or non-numeric account ID, a malformed query or a `page_key` that is not an authorization key; or a path segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded

404.description: The account has no cross-reference, account or customer record

500.description: A read failed: the program's system-error text

get.description:
ENTER on the account view: the account number as typed is edited, then the card
cross-reference is read by account, the account by the same key and the customer by the
cross-reference's customer ID. The response holds the account and customer blocks of the
map, the SSN in redacted form only. PF3 is client-side and calls no endpoint.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with the program's message and the field `acct_id`: 400 when the account
number is missing, not numeric or all zeros; 404 when the cross-reference, the account or
the customer record is not found; 500 when one of those reads fails. 401 when the request
carries no valid bearer token. A segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded is a 400
with the API's `Invalid path parameters...` and no field, before the program's edit.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: Account number as typed on the screen (11 characters)

200.description: The account and customer blocks of the view, the SSN redacted

400.description: The account number is missing, not numeric or all zeros; or a path segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded

401.description: The request carries no valid bearer token

404.description: The cross-reference, account or customer record was not found

500.description: The cross-reference, account or customer read failed

get.description:
The pending authorization the path names, as `POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS` fills `COPAU1A`: card
number, date and time, response and reason, amount, merchant and fraud status. Without
`direction` this is ENTER, `PROCESS-ENTER-KEY`: the named authorization is read and shown.
With `direction=forward` this is F8, `PROCESS-PF8-KEY`: the account's next authorization is
shown with its own `auth_key`, or the same one with `Already at the last Authorization...`.
`backward` is no key of this screen and is answered as ENTER, as the program's `WHEN OTHER`
branch does. The card number is redacted to its last four digits.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` body: 400 when the account is not eleven digits, the key is blank, the query
does not deserialise or a path segment is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded; 401 without a
valid bearer token; 404 when no authorization of the account has the key; 500 when the
summary, detail or next read fails, or the store fails.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: Account ID

parameters.name: auth_key
parameters.description: Authorization key from a summary row

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `forward` for F8, the next authorization; absent for ENTER.

200.description: The authorization as the detail screen shows it

400.description: Malformed account, blank key or invalid query; or a path segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded

404.description: No authorization of the account has the key

500.description: A summary, detail or next read failed, or the store failed

post.summary: Mark or unmark an authorization as fraud (CPVD / COPAUS1C, COPAUS2C).
post.description:
F5, `MARK-AUTH-FRAUD`: the authorization the path names is read, its fraud flag flipped, and
COPAUS2C records the report in `AUTHFRDS`, inserting the row or updating it when one is
already stored. Only after that succeeds is the detail replaced, and both writes commit
together. The answer carries `AUTH MARKED FRAUD...` or `AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...` and the
authorization as replaced, its key unchanged and its card number redacted to the last four
digits. The request has no body.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` body: 400 when the account is not eleven digits, the key is blank or a path
segment is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded; 401 without a valid bearer token; 404 when no
authorization of the account has the key; 500 when a read fails, when COPAUS2C's insert or
update or the replace of the detail fails and both writes are rolled back, or when the store
fails. Nothing is written on any error.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: Account ID

parameters.name: auth_key
parameters.description: Authorization key from a summary row

200.description: The fraud flag was flipped and committed

400.description: Malformed account or blank key; or a path segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded

404.description: No authorization of the account has the key

500.description: A read or write failed and nothing was committed

post.description:
ENTER on the bill-payment screen. With a blank confirmation it shows the current balance of
the account and asks for confirmation; with `Y` or `y` it records the payment transaction
and updates the balance; with `N` or `n` it clears the screen. F4 (clear) and F3 (back) are
handled by the screen and send no request.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with the program's message and the field the screen focuses:

- 400: a blank account ID, a confirmation other than `Y`, `y`, `N`, `n` or blank, a balance
  of zero or less (`You have nothing to pay...`), or a body that does not fit
  `BillPaymentRequest`.
- 401: no valid bearer token.
- 404: no account with the ID.
- 500: the account, the transactions or the store could not be read or written.

200.description: The screen after ENTER: the balance with the confirmation prompt, the cleared screen after `N`, or the cleared screen with the new transaction ID after a payment

400.description: A blank account ID, an invalid confirmation, a balance of zero or less, or a body that does not fit `BillPaymentRequest`

500.description: The account, the transactions or the store could not be read or written

get.description:
One page of the card list in ascending card-number order. ENTER applies the account and card
filters (`acct_id`, `card_num`); F7 and F8 page through `direction`, with the paging state of
the previous response echoed unchanged (`page_no`, `first_key`, `last_key`, `has_next_page`,
`last_page_shown`). Row selections are client-side and call no endpoint. Card numbers are
redacted to their last four digits, and every row carries its `card_ref` handle. A search
that matches no card is a 200 page with the program's no-records message.

# Errors

- 400: the query does not deserialise or breaks a field rule, or a filter fails the
  program's edit, with the program's message and the field it names.
- 401: the request carries no valid bearer token.
- 422: `page_size` lies outside 1 to 100.
- 500: a card read failed, answered with the program's file-error text, or the request failed
  internally.

parameters.name: acct_id
card_num
parameters.description:
`CARDSID`, the card filter, as typed (map `LENGTH` 16). Blank, or sixteen `0` digits, is
no filter (COCRDLIC-007); sixteen digits list only that card (COCRDLIC-010); anything else
is 400 with field `card_num` (COCRDLIC-008). Input only: never sent back.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The key pressed: `forward` for F8, `backward` for F7, absent for ENTER or any key the
program processes as ENTER (COCRDLIC-003).

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description:
The page number of the previous response, 0 to 9 (`PAGENO`, COCRDLIC-030). Absent, page 1.
Outside 0 to 9 it is 400 with field `page_no`.

parameters.name: first_key
parameters.description:
The `first_key` of the previous response: the `card_ref` that ENTER and F7 read from
(COCRDLIC-018, COCRDLIC-026, COCRDLIC-027). Absent, the browse starts below every card.

parameters.name: last_key
parameters.description:
The `last_key` of the previous response: the `card_ref` that F8 reads from while a next
page exists (COCRDLIC-023).

parameters.name: has_next_page
parameters.description:
The `has_next_page` of the previous response. Absent, no next page: F8 then re-reads the
page from `first_key` (COCRDLIC-024).

parameters.name: last_page_shown
parameters.description:
The `last_page_shown` of the previous response: whether F8 already showed the last page,
so that a further F8 answers `NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY` (COCRDLIC-024, COCRDLIC-025).
Absent, not shown.

parameters.name: reread
parameters.description:
`true` for the re-read after a selection error the screen found (COCRDLIC-014): the list
is read again from the start of the card file under the filters, the echoed page number
is kept and the key pressed still decides the messages. Absent, an ordinary request.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Rows per page, 1 to 100 (Bounded Pagination); any other value is 422. Absent, 7, the
program's screen size. The screen never sends it.

200.description: One page of the card list: at most `page_size` rows, each with its `card_ref` handle and redacted card number, the page number, the paging state to echo and both message lines.

400.description: The query does not deserialise or breaks a field rule, or a filter is neither blank nor all digits; the body names the field.

401.description: The request carries no valid bearer token.

422.description: Returned only when `page_size` is outside 1 to 100 (Bounded Pagination).

500.description: A card read failed, answered with the program's file-error text, or the request failed internally.

get.summary: Fetch a card for update (CCUP / COCRDUPC).
get.description:
ENTER with the account and card search keys, or with the `card_ref` handle of a card list row
in place of the card number: the card as the update screen shows it, its number redacted
beside its `card_ref` handle, and the snapshot that every request of the save operation
echoes. The account shown is the one requested.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` carrying the program's message: 400 when a search key fails its edit or the
query does not fit its screen fields, 401 without a valid bearer token, 404 when no card has
the number or handle, and 500 when the card read fails.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: `ACCTSID` (`ACCTSIDI PIC X(11)`): the account number, 11 digits (COCRDSL-013).

parameters.name: card_num
parameters.description:
`CARDSID` (`CARDSIDI PIC X(16)`): the card number as typed, 16 digits (COCRDSL-016).
Never sent together with `card_ref`.

parameters.name: card_ref
parameters.description:
The `cards.card_ref` handle of the card (CVACT02Y-008), from a COCRDLI list row or from
an earlier [`CardViewResponse`] (COCRDSLC-006, COCRDSLC-026). Never sent together with
`card_num`.

200.description: The card with its number redacted, and the snapshot to echo

400.description: A search key failed its edit, or the query does not fit its fields

401.description: The request carries no valid bearer token

404.description: No card has the number or handle searched for

500.description: The card read failed

get.description:
ENTER on the card detail screen: the card is selected by its key alone, either the typed
`card_num` or the `card_ref` handle of a card list row, never both. `acct_id` is validated by
COCRDSLC's account edit and returned as the displayed account; it is never compared with the
card's stored account, so a card held by another account is shown under the account entered.
The card number is returned in full only to an administrator token; any other token receives
twelve asterisks followed by the last four digits. The response carries no card verification
code.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with the status of the step that failed: 400 when the query does not
deserialise, exceeds a screen field length or fails COCRDSLC's account and card edits; 401
without a valid bearer token; 404 when no card has the number or handle; 500 when the card
read fails.

parameters.name: acct_id
parameters.description: `ACCTSID` (`ACCTSIDI PIC X(11)`): the account number, 11 digits (COCRDSL-013).

parameters.name: card_num
parameters.description:
`CARDSID` (`CARDSIDI PIC X(16)`): the card number as typed, 16 digits (COCRDSL-016).
Never sent together with `card_ref`.

parameters.name: card_ref
parameters.description:
The `cards.card_ref` handle of the card (CVACT02Y-008), from a COCRDLI list row or from
an earlier [`CardViewResponse`] (COCRDSLC-006, COCRDSLC-026). Never sent together with
`card_num`.

200.description: The card; its number in full for an administrator token, otherwise redacted to its last four digits

400.description: The query failed request validation or a COCRDSLC account or card edit

404.description: No card has the number or handle

500.description: The card read failed

put.summary: Validate or save a card update (CCUP / COCRDUPC).
put.description:
`aid` ENTER edits the name, the status and the expiry month and year against the echoed
snapshot and, when they pass, asks for confirmation. `aid` PF5 in state
`changes_ok_not_confirmed` runs the change check and the edits again and rewrites the card
the `card_ref` path segment names; PF5 in any other state is processed as ENTER. After a
save, a lock failure or a rewrite failure, the next request restarts the search. The stored
card number and verification code are never taken from the request.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` carrying the program's message: 400 when nothing changed, a field fails its
edit or the body does not fit its screen fields; 401 without a valid bearer token; 409 when
the card changed after it was fetched; 500 when the card cannot be locked for update, a
`card_ref` that names no card included, or when its rewrite fails. A segment that is not
UTF-8 once percent-decoded is a 400 with the API's `Invalid path parameters...` and no
field, before the body is read.

parameters.name: card_ref
parameters.description: Card handle from the fetch or list response

200.description: The changes validated, the card saved, or the search restarted

400.description: Nothing changed, a field failed its edit, or the body does not fit; or a path segment that is not UTF-8 once percent-decoded

401.description: The request carries no valid bearer token

409.description: The card changed after it was fetched

500.description: The card could not be locked for update, or its rewrite failed

get.description:
Returns the administrator option table: the six `COADM02Y` options in table order, each with
its number, display text, program and admin-only and installed flags, and the invalid-option
and not-installed texts. ENTER's option checks, the transfers and PF3 run in the screen,
without a further request.

# Errors

401 without a valid token and 403 for a token whose user type is not `A`, both answered by the
`AdminUser` extractor before the service runs.

200.description: The admin menu: the six `COADM02Y` options in table order and the program's invalid-option and not-installed texts

401.description: No valid bearer token: the request is refused before the menu is built

403.description: A valid token whose user type is not `A`: the admin gate refuses it

get.description:
Returns the 11 options of `COMEN02Y` in table order with their admin-only and installed flags,
the user type of the bearer token and the program's rejection texts. The ENTER option checks,
the transfers and PF3 run in the screen from this response, with no further request.

# Errors

401 with a `ScreenError` when the request carries no valid bearer token.

200.description: The main menu: the option table with its flags and the rejection texts

post.description:
ENTER on the report screen: the Monthly or Yearly report of the current date, or a Custom report
of the start and end dates the request carries, each date part as the screen typed it. A
confirmation of `Y` or `y` writes the job deck that runs the report and answers the submission
message, such as `Monthly report submitted for printing ...`, with `job_deck`, the name of the
deck's generation file, such as `TRNRPT00.G0001`. A confirmation of `N` or `n` clears the
screen: an empty message and no `job_deck`. The report itself is not produced here. PF3 is
client-side.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with the status CORPT00C's audit assigns:

- 400: a body that does not fit the map's fields, no report selected, a blank or invalid date
  part, a date that fails the date check, or a blank or invalid confirmation, each with the
  program's message and the field it names.
- 401: no valid bearer token.
- 500: `Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...` when the job deck cannot be written, or
  `Unable to process request...` for an internal failure.

200.description: Submitted, with the job deck's file name, or cleared

400.description: A map field, report selection, date part or confirmation edit failed

500.description: The job deck could not be written, or an internal failure

post.description:
ENTER on the sign-on screen: validates the user ID and the password, upper-cases both as the
program does, reads the user by the upper-cased ID, verifies the password against the stored
hash and returns a bearer token for every other operation, with the user ID, the user type
and the route of the menu the program transfers to. F3 and every other key are handled by the
screen and send no request.

# Errors

- 400: the body is not a sign-on request, a field holds more than its 8 screen positions or a
  character no screen field carries, or the user ID or the password is blank.
- 401: no user has the user ID, or the password does not match the stored one.
- 500: the user could not be read or verified, or the token could not be issued.

200.description: Signed on: the bearer token, the user ID and type, and the next route

400.description: A malformed body, an over-long or unprintable field, or a blank field

401.description: No user with this user ID, or a password that does not match

500.description: The user could not be read or verified, or no token could be issued

get.description:
Endpoint 24: seven rows of the Db2 data version of the transaction types,
`db2.transaction_type`, with the page number, the messages, the `state` the screen echoes with
ENTER and F10, and the opaque `page_key` it echoes with F7 and F8. An administrator token is
required.

Without `direction` the request is the screen load: page 1 under no filter, every other member
ignored. With `direction` and the `page_key` of the previous response it is F7 (`backward`) or
F8 (`forward`) under `type_filter` and `desc_filter`, the filters on the screen, whose edits run
as on ENTER, so a changed filter moves to page 1 of it. F2 (add, to CTTU) and F3 (exit) call no
endpoint.

# Errors

400 with the page for a filter in error, or with a `ScreenError` for a query the request rules
reject or a `page_key` this API did not issue; 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token whose
user type is not `A`; 422 for a `page_size` outside 1 to 100; 500 with the page and its Db2
message when the count or the page read fails, or with a `ScreenError` carrying
`Db2 access failure. ` when the database cannot be reached (COTRTLIC-053).

parameters.name: type_filter
parameters.description:
The type filter on the screen when F7 or F8 is pressed, `TRTYPEI PIC X(2)`, as typed:
the domain's type-filter edit owns its message.

parameters.name: desc_filter
parameters.description: The description filter on the screen, `TRDESCI PIC X(50)`, as typed.

parameters.name: page_key
parameters.description:
The `page_key` of the previous response, echoed unchanged; the screen never builds one.
Absent or empty, the request is the screen load.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `forward` for F8, `backward` for F7; absent, the request is the screen load.

schema.description:
The paging key of a collection request: `forward` (F8) or `backward` (F7). Absent, the
request is ENTER or a first entry.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Rows per page, 1 to 100, 7 when absent; a page never holds more than the seven
positions of the map. Outside 1 to 100 the request is rejected with 422 (Bounded
Pagination).

200.description: The page: rows, page number, messages, `state` and `page_key`

400.description: Either body: the page with a filter in error and its message, or a `ScreenError` for a query the request rules reject or a `page_key` this API did not issue

401.description: No bearer token, or one that is invalid or expired

403.description: The token's user type is not `A` (admin gate)

500.description: Either body: the page, with the rows read before the failure and the program's Db2 message, when the count or the page read failed, or a `ScreenError` carrying `Db2 access failure. ` when the database cannot be reached

post.summary: Validate or confirm list actions (CTLI / COTRTLIC).
post.description:
Endpoint 25: the key, the two filters, the seven selections and descriptions as typed, and the
`state` of the previous response echoed unchanged. It answers with the page as re-read, or the
state's rows where nothing was read, the per-row errors, the messages, what was committed and
the new `state`. An administrator token is required.

ENTER (`aid` `ENTER`) edits the selections against the state as received, then the
description filter, then the type filter. A valid single `U` or `D` returns the confirmation
prompt with the action pending in `state`; a changed filter re-reads page 1 of it and keeps
every selection at its row position.

F10 (`aid` `PF10`) commits the pending update or delete only when one is pending and the type
filter, the description filter and the selected row are all unchanged; otherwise it is
processed exactly as ENTER. F2 (add, to CTTU) and F3 (exit) call no endpoint.

# Errors

400 with the page and the per-row errors for an input error or a delete the type's categories
restrict, or with a `ScreenError` for a body the request rules reject or a `state` no screen
could hold; 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token whose user type is not `A`; 404 with the
page when the row to commit was deleted by another user; 422 for a `page_size` outside 1 to
100; 500 with the page and its Db2 message when a Db2 statement fails, with a `ScreenError`
carrying `Db2 access failure. ` when the database cannot be reached (COTRTLIC-053), or with a
`ScreenError` when the commit's transaction cannot be opened, committed or rolled back or its
re-read of the target row fails.

200.description: The page, the messages, what was committed and the new `state`

400.description: Either body: the page with the per-row errors and the message of an input error or of a delete the type's categories restrict, or a `ScreenError` for a body the request rules reject or a `state` no screen could hold

401.description: No bearer token, or one that is invalid or expired

403.description: The token's user type is not `A` (admin gate)

404.description: The page and the message of a row another user deleted before the commit

500.description: Either body: the page and the program's Db2 message of a failed statement, or a `ScreenError` carrying `Db2 access failure. ` when the database cannot be reached, or `Unable to process request...` when the commit's transaction cannot be opened, committed or rolled back or its re-read of the target row fails

get.description:
ENTER on the fresh screen: `1000-PROCESS-INPUTS` stores and edits the code typed in
`TRTYPCDI`, and `9000-READ-TRANTYPE` reads the row it names from `db2.transaction_type`. A row
found is shown with its description in state `show_details` (COTRTUPC-009); a valid code no
row holds answers 200 in state `details_not_found` with the error row `No record found for
this key in database` and the prompt to add it with F5 (COTRTUPC-010).

Requires the bearer token of an administrator, user type `A` (COTRTUPC-001).

# Errors

- 400 naming `type_code` when the code is longer than its two-character map field
  (`COTRTUP-013`) or the key edits refuse it: blank, not numeric or zero (COTRTUPC-005 to
  COTRTUPC-007). Nothing is read.
- 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token whose user type is not `A`.
- 500 when the read fails, with the program's fixed message prefix (COTRTUPC-011).

parameters.name: type_code
parameters.description: Transaction type code as typed on the screen (2 characters)

200.description: The type shown, or the add prompt for a code no row holds

400.description: The code is longer than 2 characters, or the key edits refused it

403.description: The token's user type is not A

500.description: The read of the transaction type failed

post.summary: Save or delete a transaction type (CTTU / COTRTUPC).
post.description:
`{type_code}` is the code the screen shows, and `aid` the key pressed:

- `ENTER`: `1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS` edits the description typed in `TRTYDSCI`. A valid change
  answers state `changes_ok_not_confirmed` with the prompt to save it with F5; nothing is
  written (COTRTUPC-016 to COTRTUPC-021).
- `PF5`: `9600-WRITE-PROCESSING` saves the validated description, an update of the row, or
  the insert of `9700-INSERT-RECORD` when no row holds the code, and commits it; the answer is
  state `changes_okayed_and_done` (COTRTUPC-023 to COTRTUPC-026).
- `PF4`: the second F4, after the screen asked to confirm the delete: `9800-DELETE-PROCESSING`
  deletes the row and commits; the answer is state `delete_done` (COTRTUPC-032).

Any other key is answered `Invalid key pressed`, with nothing read or written (COTRTUPC-043).
The service re-reads the row for `{type_code}` and derives the state it serves from it; no
state the screen holds is sent or trusted.

Requires the bearer token of an administrator, user type `A` (COTRTUPC-001).

# Errors

- 400 for an unserved key, a code longer than 2 or a description longer than 50 characters,
  a body that does not deserialise, and the key, description and no-change edits
  (COTRTUPC-005, COTRTUPC-017 to COTRTUPC-019, COTRTUPC-043). Nothing is written.
- 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token whose user type is not `A`.
- 500 when a store statement fails, with the program's fixed message prefix and nothing
  written: the update, insert, lock and delete failures, the delete refused while categories
  exist (COTRTUPC-027 to COTRTUPC-029, COTRTUPC-033, COTRTUPC-034), and the failed re-read
  (COTRTUPC-038).

get.description:
ENTER searches from `start_tran_id`, or from the lowest transaction when it is blank. F8
(`direction` `forward`) and F7 (`backward`) page from the `last_key` and `first_key` the
previous response returned, which the screen echoes with `page_no` and `has_next_page`;
`entry_key` names the transfer that brought the screen up. Every page is re-read from
`transactions`, so the echoed state grants nothing. A page holds `page_size` row slots, ten
by default, and no row carries a card number. The `S` selection to the transaction view and
F3 to the main menu are client-side.

# Errors

- 401 without a valid bearer token, answered before the query is read.
- 400 `Tran ID must be Numeric ...` on `start_tran_id` for an ENTER whose search value is
  neither blank nor 16 digits, and 400 for a query that does not deserialise or breaks a
  field rule.
- 422 for a `page_size` outside 1 to 100.
- 500 `Unable to lookup transaction...` when the page cannot be read, and 500 for a store
  failure without an audited message.

Read on ENTER only.

COTRN00C-013), so 0 is admitted.

post.description:
`ENTER` runs COTRN02C's key edits, cross-reference read and data edits on the request's
fields: a blank, `N` or `n` confirmation answers with the confirmation prompt and the edited
fields, and `Y` or `y` adds the transaction and answers with its new ID. `PF5` first copies
the data fields of the transaction with the highest ID, then runs `ENTER` on them. `F4`
(clear) and `PF3` (back) are the screen's own and send no request. The card number in the
response is redacted to its last four digits.

# Errors

A [`ScreenError`] with the program's message and field:

- 400: a COTRN02C edit failed, the confirmation is not `Y`, `N` or blank, the key is neither
  `ENTER` nor `PF5`, or the body is unreadable or exceeds a map field length.
- 401: the request carries no valid bearer token; nothing is read.
- 404: the account or card has no cross-reference, or `PF5` finds no transaction to copy.
- 500: a read or the write failed, or the new transaction ID already exists.

get.description:
ENTER reads the transaction whose ID the Tran ID input holds, sent as the `tran_id` path
segment exactly as typed, and returns the detail fields of the `COTRN1A` map. Every signed-on
user gets the same view, whatever the user type. The card number is returned redacted to its
last four characters, and the original and processing timestamps are typed, `null` when
blank. F4, F5 and PF3 send no request. Nothing is locked or written.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` naming field `tran_id`: 400 `Input does not fit the screen field...` when
the Tran ID is longer than its 16 characters, with nothing read (COTRN01-013), 400 `Tran ID
can NOT be empty...` when it is blank, 404 `Transaction ID NOT found...` when no transaction
has the key, and 500 `Unable to lookup Transaction...` when the read fails. A request without
a valid bearer token is refused with 401 before any input is examined. A segment that is not
UTF-8 once percent-decoded is a 400 with the API's `Invalid path parameters...` and no field,
before the program's edit.

ENTER lists from `start_user_id`, or from the first user ID when it is absent or blank. F8
(`direction` forward) and F7 (`direction` backward) page from the state the previous
response returned, echoed as `page_key`, `first_key`, `last_key`, `page_no` and
`has_next_page`. A page holds `page_size` row positions, 10 by default; a row carries the
user ID, first and last name and user type, never a password. The `U` and `D` row selections
and F3 are handled by the screen and send no request. An administrator token is required.

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with status 400 when a query parameter does not parse or breaks its length
or range rule; 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 when the token's user type is not `A`;
422 when `page_size` lies outside 1 to 100; 500 when the users cannot be read.

with no edit; absent or blank, from the first user (COUSR00C-012). F7 and F8 ignore it
(COUSR00C-017). At most the map's 8 characters (COUSR00-015).

`forward` (COUSR00C-017, COUSR00C-022). Takes the place of `first_key` or `last_key`
respectively; ignored without a `direction`.

empty, the user is added and the message names its user ID, such as `User NEWUSR01 has been

A `ScreenError`, checked in this order:

- 401 without a valid bearer token (COUSR01C-002);
- 403 when the token's user type is not `A` (COUSR01C-001);
- 400 for a body that does not deserialise or a value its map field cannot hold, then for
  the first empty field, and for a user ID already stored, `User ID already exist...`

- 500 `Unable to Add User...` when the user cannot be stored (COUSR01C-024).

path `user_id`, with the prompt each screen shows after the read (`update_prompt` for
COUSR02C, `delete_prompt` for COUSR03C). The password and its hash are never returned. An
administrator token (`usr_type` `A`) is required.

# Errors

- 400 `User ID can NOT be empty...` (`field` `user_id`) for a blank user ID, and the API's
  fixed text naming `user_id` for one longer than 8 bytes or not printable ASCII.
- 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 for a token whose user type is not `A`.
- 404 `User ID NOT found...` (`field` `user_id`) when no user has the ID.
- 500 `Unable to lookup User...` (`field` `first_name`) when the read fails.

put.description:
PF5 (`F5=Save`), and the save F3 (`F3=Save&Exit`) performs before the screen leaves: the
names and type of the user under the path `user_id` are rewritten when any of them, or the
password, differs from the stored row. An omitted or null `password` keeps the stored one; a
supplied one is checked against the stored hash and replaces it only when it differs. ENTER
is the fetch, `GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}`; F4 (clear) and F12 (cancel) send no request.
No password is returned. An administrator token (`usr_type` `A`) is required.

# Errors

- 400 for a path user ID or a body that does not fit the screen fields, for the first
  empty-field edit that fails, in the program's order (user ID, first name, last name, a
  supplied password, user type), and `Please modify to update ...` when nothing differs from
  the stored row.
- 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 for a token whose user type is not `A`.
- 404 `User ID NOT found...` (`field` `user_id`) when no user has the ID.
- 500 `Unable to lookup User...` or `Unable to Update User...` (`field` `first_name`) when
  the read, the password check or the rewrite fails.

delete.description:
F5 deletes the user whose ID is in the path, the ID the screen fetched through the shared
user read (endpoint 18) or typed afresh: the screen sends it as it stands and asks no other
confirmation (COUSR03C-023). The path `user_id` is the text of the user ID input, at most its
8 bytes; it is padded to its 8-byte key, neither upper-cased nor trimmed, and a blank one is
rejected before any read (COUSR03C-016, COUSR03C-017). A deleted user answers with the
program's message, such as `User USER0001 has been deleted ...` (COUSR03C-019,
COUSR03C-020).

F4, F12 and F3 are handled by the screen and call no endpoint. An administrator token is
required: the caller acts only as the verified `AdminUser`, and nothing compares it with the
target, so an administrator may delete any user, their own included (COUSR03C-002,
COUSR03C-024).

# Errors

A `ScreenError` with its audited status:

- 400 `User ID can NOT be empty...` on `user_id` for a blank path ID (COUSR03C-016), and the
  API's fixed text on `user_id` for one longer than 8 bytes or not printable ASCII
  (COUSR03-013);
- 401 without a valid bearer token and 403 for a token whose user type is not `A`, from the
  `AdminUser` extractor, before the service runs (COUSR03C-001, COUSR03C-002);
- 404 `User ID NOT found...` on `user_id` for a delete that affects no row (COUSR03C-021);
- 500 `Unable to Update User...` on `first_name` for a failed delete, and for a path ID with
  no row or a failed read, which leave nothing held for the delete (COUSR03C-018,
  COUSR03C-022); 500 with the API's fixed text when the store transaction cannot begin,
  commit or roll back.

The five amounts as the screen shows them after endpoint 6 validated or saved them: each the
15-character `+ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99` string of its value (COACTUPC-078, COACTUPC-109).

AccountUpdateFields.description:
The raw text of every enterable map field of an endpoint 6 request, at most its map
`LENGTH`.

An absent member is the empty text, which the program reads as blank. The account number is
the path's `acct_id`. The SSN parts are present only when the operator re-entered them:
omitting all three means unchanged, a part omitted beside a present one is blank
(COACTUPC-064). They are never serialised, so a body carrying them is written as JSON, and
`Debug` prints them as `***`.

ssn_part2.description: `ACTSSN2` (2): the fourth and fifth SSN digits, only when re-entered.

whose `state` the last response set (COACTUPC-100).

a restart, which has no error message (COACTUPC-014, COACTUPC-108).

The fields keep the text the request sent, except the amounts, which `amounts` gives as
shown. `state` is the code the client writes into `snapshot.state` for its next request.

save`, `Changes committed to database` or `Enter or update id of account to update`

AccountUpdateSnapshot.description:
`ACUP-OLD-DETAILS` and `ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION`: the values endpoint 5 fetched, which the client
echoes in every endpoint 6 request (COACTUPC-100).

Text members hold the stored field in full, trailing spaces included; IDs and the FICO score
are their digits; amounts are plain decimal strings such as `-1940.00`; dates are typed,
`null` for a blank field. The SSN is only its last four digits (E32). A value the client
alters is read as unknown and equals nothing, so it counts as a change and, at a save, as a
record changed by another user: the snapshot grants nothing.

`ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION`: a space before a fetch, `S` details shown, `E` changes not OK,
`N` changes validated, `C` saved, `L` lock failed, `F` rewrite failed.

AccountUpdateView.description:
The 200 body of endpoint 5: the account and customer as `CACTUPA` shows them in state `S`,
with the snapshot the client echoes (COACTUPC-068, COACTUPC-074 to COACTUPC-077).

Every member but the dates, the SSN and the snapshot carries the name of the
[`AccountUpdateFields`] member the screen sends it back in. Text is every byte of its map
field as stored, trailing spaces included; amounts are the 15-character `+ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99`
strings; dates are typed, `null` for a blank one, and the screen splits them into the map's

characters 2-4, 6-8 and 10-13 of the stored number (COACTUPC-074, COACTUPC-075,
COACTUPC-077). The SSN is `***-**-` and its last four digits (COACTUPC-076); no card number
is held.
